# claude-skills

A Claude Code plugin marketplace.

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add CJHwong/claude-skills
```

Then install the plugins you want:

```
/plugin install agents-md-skill@claude-skills
/plugin install sort-later@claude-skills
```

## Plugins

| Plugin | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| [agents-md-skill](plugins/agents-md-skill) | Write AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md files that actually help coding agents |
| [sort-later](plugins/sort-later) | Organize bookmarks into Obsidian notes and browser bookmark files |
files.plugins/sort-later/README.md:
# sort-later

Organize bookmarks from any source into articles and functional sites.

Takes a pile of bookmarks — browser exports, Pocket, Raindrop, Instapaper, or plain URL lists — and splits them into two buckets:

- **Articles** (things you read) get scraped, converted to markdown, and organized into an Obsidian vault with concept tags and backlinks
- **Functional sites** (things you use) become a tidy browser-importable HTML bookmark file with sensible folders

Also handles deduplication, dead link detection, and tag cleanup.

## Examples

**Import browser bookmarks:**
> "I exported my Chrome bookmarks, help me sort through them."

**Process a read-later export:**
> "Here's my Pocket export, do something with it."

**Build an Obsidian vault:**
> "I've got 500 saved articles, turn them into something I can search."

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add CJHwong/claude-skills
/plugin install sort-later@claude-skills
```

# agents-md-skill

Write AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md files that actually help coding agents.

Most auto-generated context files make agents worse — a study across 438 tasks and four agents (arXiv:2602.11988v1, ETH Zurich, Feb 2026) found they reduce success rates by 2-3% and increase cost by 20%. This skill applies those findings: it keeps only what agents can't discover through their own tools and cuts everything else.

## What it does

- Audits existing AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md files against research-backed criteria
- Creates new context files from scratch by exploring the codebase
- Handles monorepos with nested context files — promotes buried content, removes duplication
- Works on any repo, any language

## Examples

**Audit an existing file:**
> "Review my project's CLAUDE.md and tell me what's actually useful."

**Create from scratch:**
> "Generate an AGENTS.md for this project."

**Clean up a monorepo:**
> "This repo has CLAUDE.md files scattered across subdirectories, clean them up."

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add CJHwong/claude-skills
/plugin install agents-md-skill@claude-skills
```
